name: Bangla Calendar Display
author: Md Shorov Abedin

sections.description:
Bangla Calendar Display shows the current Bengali (Bangla) date and time on your WordPress site. Version 1.0.10 embeds all required styles inline (no external CSS files) and extends the settings page with a border‑radius option alongside colour and font size controls. It also improves the shortcode copy functionality and ensures the live preview reflects all style choices. The admin page includes a live preview and a shortcode generator.

Features

  • Calculates the Bangla date based on the Gregorian calendar and handles leap years and Pohela Boishakh (14 April) transitions.
  • Multiple display templates: simple inline text, modern card, stacked grid and a dual calendar showing the equivalent Gregorian date.
  • Customise which parts to show (time, weekday, date only) and adjust colours and font size using the built‑in colour pickers.
  • Settings page in the WordPress dashboard (under Bangla Calendar) lets you choose the layout, timezone and colours and see a live preview of your selections.
  • Automatically generates the shortcode for you — copy it with one click to embed the calendar anywhere on your site.
  • Shortcode attributes allow per‑use overrides of any option.
  • Fully translation‑ready (Text Domain: bangla-calendar-display) and supports any timezone.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bangla-calendar-display folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install via the WordPress Plugin Installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Bangla Calendar in your dashboard to configure the layout, colours and other options. Use the live preview to see how it will look.
  4. Copy the generated shortcode (or use [msabcd_bangla_calendar]) into any post, page or widget to display the calendar.
sections.faq:
How do I use the Bangla Calendar?

After activating the plugin, visit Bangla Calendar in your dashboard to choose your preferred style, colours and other settings. A live preview will show you exactly how the calendar will look.

To display the calendar on a post, page or widget area, insert the shortcode:

`

[msabcd_bangla_calendar]
`

The settings page also generates a customised shortcode based on your choices — click Copy Shortcode to copy it. You can paste this shortcode anywhere shortcodes are supported.

Can I customise each calendar instance differently?

Yes. You can override any setting via shortcode attributes. Supported attributes include:

  • display_view – simple, modern, grid or dual
  • format – time_date_weekday, date_weekday, time_date, date_only, time_only
  • show_time – 1 or 0
  • show_suffix – 1 or 0
  • timezone – e.g. Asia/Dhaka
  • color_primary, color_bg, font_size – override the colours or font size

Example:

`

[msabcd_bangla_calendar display_view=”grid” format=”date_weekday” color_primary=”#00a32a”]
`
sections.changelog:
1.0.10

  • Fixed CSS and JavaScript assets loading issues so that the calendar styles and preview work reliably across sites. All styles are delivered inline for better compatibility.
  • Added support for a border radius option in the settings page and shortcode. You can now adjust the roundness of calendar corners.
  • Improved the shortcode copy functionality: the Copy Shortcode button now attempts several methods to place the shortcode on the clipboard, providing reliable fallback behaviour.
  • Enhanced admin preview to reflect all styling options (primary colour, background colour, font size and border radius) in real time.
  • Bumped version numbers in the plugin code and script to avoid caching issues and updated the stable tag to 1.0.10.

1.0.9

  • All styles are now output inline; the plugin no longer loads an external CSS file.
  • Added a new Border radius option in the settings page, letting you control the roundness of calendar corners.
  • Fixed the Copy Shortcode button to work reliably across different browsers and contexts.
  • Updated the admin preview to reflect the selected border radius, colour and font size settings.
  • Bumped version numbers to prevent caching of outdated assets.

1.0.7

  • Added live preview and shortcode generator to the settings page, allowing you to see the calendar instantly and copy the shortcode with one click.
  • Added AJAX handler and admin JavaScript to update the preview dynamically as settings are changed.
  • Enqueued front‑end styles in the admin area so the preview matches the front end.
  • Updated plugin header and readme to version 1.0.7 and improved the overall user experience.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of Bangla Calendar Display plugin.
